summary: Write M = (N d)^L·d′·r and apply `mem_raises_of_standardData` to d′·f, then scale by the integer (Nd)^L·r.

steps.claim: Write M = d′(Nd)^L·r and regroup M·f = ((Nd)^L·r)·(d′·f).

d′·f ∈ raises(k, 1, 1, (|ιₚ c|/|ιₚ(N̄ d)|)^L) (`mem_raises_of_standardData`, δ = N ≠ 0); multiplying by (Nd)^L·r, whose ιₚ-norm is ≤ |ιₚ(N d)|^L (an integer), gives the bound |ιₚ c|^L ≤ 1 (`Kernel.smul_mem_raises`).
steps.lean:
use Kernel.smul_mem_raises _ (mem_raises_of_standardData out hf)
    (by have := @ne ℕ _; grw [hc]; simp [IsUltrametricDist.norm_natCast_le_one, mul_pow, field, *])
